# Luis Iglesias — Software & Web Developer

> Full-content Markdown export of luisiglesias.dev, for LLMs and agents. See /llms.txt for the curated index.

## About

I turn interfaces into things people actually enjoy using — fast, accessible, built to last.

Trained as a Fachinformatiker für Anwendungsentwicklung at Kühne+Nagel, then freelanced through Re:frame e.V. before joining FLOW4 Webdesign full-time, where I build digital platforms with Nuxt and Vue. Alongside that I run Iglesias Web Agency, my own studio for businesses that want a site that doesn't look like everyone else's.

- 11+ side & client projects shipped and live
- 4 languages: German, Spanish, English, Portuguese
- Current focus: Nuxt.js, Vue.js, WordPress, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, UX & Performance

## Experience

### Webentwickler — FLOW4 Webdesign UG & Co. KG
Jan 2026 — Present · Full-time · Remote

Building modern web platforms with Nuxt.js and Vue.js, custom WordPress and Strapi solutions for client projects, and responsive, TypeScript-driven frontends with Tailwind CSS.

Stack: Nuxt.js, Vue.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, WordPress, Strapi

### Entwickler — Re:frame e.V.
Sept 2024 — Oct 2025 · Freelance · Remote

Georeferenced historical place names and integrated data from OpenStreetMap and Wikidata. Built Python scripts to automate enrichment and processing, with quality and plausibility checks on the resulting geodata.

Stack: Python, OpenStreetMap, Wikidata, Data Integration

### Fachinformatiker für Anwendungsentwicklung — Kühne+Nagel
Aug 2022 — Jul 2025 · Ausbildung · Hybrid

Trained in full-stack application development — Java and Spring Boot on the backend, Angular and Vue on the frontend — working in Scrum teams and collaborating closely with the frontend department.

Stack: Java, Spring Boot, Angular, Git, Scrum

https://velaros.eu · https://www.iglesias-web-agency.de/work/velaros

Custom-built e-commerce shop with its own integrated CRM for a one-person team to run — no rigid template, no admin overload. 1.0s load time, 98 Lighthouse (desktop), +40% sales since launch.

Tags: Nuxt 3, Strapi 5, E-Commerce, CRM

### Nex Trading Intelligence — Client (Iglesias Web Agency)
https://nextrading-intelligence.com · https://www.iglesias-web-agency.de/work/nex-trading-intelligence

Trading education platform built to feel credible from the first scroll — restrained dark UI, GSAP-choreographed hero, scroll-driven sequences guiding visitors toward the community. 1.3s load time, 95 Lighthouse (desktop).

Tags: Nuxt 4, TypeScript, SCSS, GSAP

## Privacy

This site collects no data of its own — no cookies, no analytics, no tracking scripts. Contact is handled via a plain `mailto:` link, not a form that submits anywhere. Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts and hosting is on Vercel; neither is used by this site to track visitors. Full policy: https://www.luisiglesias.dev/privacy
